messages:
Anya: heads up — fp8 kernel on the H100 pool is showing a small but consistent bias after warmup when we reuse KV caches across requests. noticed during shadow runs vs prod-int8 baseline. :thinking_face:
Sam: can you paste the eval delta?
Anya: on our eval shard (wiki+conv subset) perplexity went from 12.34 -> 12.82 after enabling fp8 tiling on h100 (same model, same prompts). that's ~+3.9% ppl, and a measured 0.7% exact-match drop on a handful of QA evals. not catastrophic but reproducible.
Leo: interesting — is this correlated with long-prefix contexts or short?
Anya: mostly long-prefix. triggers when seq_len > 2048 and we hit KV reuse paths. shorter contexts see <0.2% change.
Marta: do you have logs or a reproduction script?
Anya: yes. repro steps: ```
# on canary pool
export MODEL=redwood-13b-v2
run_shadow --model $MODEL --quant fp8 --device h100 --prefix-len 2500 --requests 1000 --trace activation_stats
```
Anya: sample trace output (trimmed): ```
layer_10: activation_scale: 0.142 -> 0.137
layer_10: out_std_before_quant: 0.081 -> 0.079
kv_reuse_count: 1
warning: activation_clamp_tripped: false
```
Sam: so small scale drift per layer accumulates across layers and affects logits slightly. could be per-layer clamp/scale math ordering on fp8 kernels (vs our fp32 reference).
Leo: have we seen anything similar on L40S?
Anya: yes, L40S shows same sign but smaller magnitude (+1.5% ppl). thought it might be h100-specific tiling, but both hardware runtimes share the fp8 math path.
Marta: did you try toggling prefix fusion or disabling kv cache reuse?
Anya: quick tests: disabling prefix fusion reduced delta by ~40%. disabling kv-reuse entirely brought ppl back to baseline but at huge perf cost.
Sam: could be that our cumulative quant rounding happens when we merge cached KV blocks with newly quantized activations. one idea: perform one extra reclamp/rescale step when stitching cached kv to current batch.
Leo: also check whether attention softmax numeric differences shift due to ordering of matmul reductions on new kernels. small float reorderings can change distribution.
Anya: good point. I ran a diff of attention pre-softmax logits (float32 ref vs fp8 kernel dequantized) and differences amplify in tails. attaching a short CSV in the core repro.
Marta: pragmatic mitigation for rollout: create an allowlist for models/pools where fp8 tiling enabled only for seq_len <= 2048, fallback to int8/awq beyond. then run a longer shadow with reclamp patch.
Sam: agree. also add a per-layer diagnostic heatmap to console (red if activation_scale drift > 3%). will help catch this earlier.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: kernel/fp8-tiling-v3 -> h100-canary (owner: infra). ETA 10m. :rocket:
Anya: notes from quick bisect: problem seems amplified when using multi-sample batching (batch size > 8) with heterogeneous seq lengths. single-request shadow shows <0.5% delta.
Leo: that suggests batching alignment or padding quantization behavior may be part of it. padding tokens influence activation scaling if scaling computed per-batch.
Marta: action items: 1) add reclamp stitch step in kernel (Anya/Sam), 2) add console heatmap + per-layer drift alert (Sam), 3) restrict fp8 tiling for longprefix on canary (Marta), 4) schedule 24h shadow run comparing reclamp vs baseline (Anya).
Sam: implementation detail — reclamp step should be cheap: when we dequantize cached KV, compute per-tensor max_abs and enforce rescale to current activation_scale before concatenation. pseudo: ```
for each layer:
  s_cached = max_abs(cached_kv)
  s_cur = activation_scale_current
  if abs(s_cached - s_cur) > EPS:
    scale_factor = s_cur / max(s_cached, 1e-6)
    cached_kv *= scale_factor
```
Anya: I'll prototype and run the 1h smoke. will post perf counters.
Marta: also add a canary test that uses interleaved seq lengths to catch padding-related regressions.
Leo: FYI, we should test GPTQ/AWQ variants too — sometimes they hide the drift differently because of per-channel quantization. not all quant schemes behave the same with KV stitching.
Anya: noted. initial priority: fix fp8 kernel behavior for tiling on H100, then run AWQ/GPTQ comparators.
Sam: thanks. if someone from ops sees increased error logs for canary pool, ping this thread.
Marta: SGTM. let's keep the rollback plan ready: rollback fp8-tiling-v3 -> previous commit if shadow ppl delta > 2.5% over 12h.
Anya: uploading smoke traces now. will update thread with numbers in ~30m. :eyes:
